verdict.rationale: Vapi's docs mention an 'observability' section (evals-quickstart) and assistant-hooks that 'automate actions when specific events occur during a call', plus server-url events for tool calls, which could underpin some monitoring/alerting, but there is no explicit documentation of live call dashboards, error-rate metrics, or alerting on agent misbehavior/error spikes. missing for 10: dedicated live-monitoring dashboard, error-rate/alerting configuration, incident/alert integrations (PagerDuty/Slack), independent evidence of production monitoring use.
